steps.instruction: Boil {{ing:egg-medium}} 9 minutes. Cool in cold water. Peel.
Halve lengthways. Scoop the yolks into a bowl.
Mash the yolks with {{ing:mayonnaise}} and {{ing:mustard-dijon}} until smooth.
Spoon back into the whites.
Dust with {{ing:smoked-paprika}}. Snip over {{ing:chives}}.
Chop {{ing:smoked-salmon}}.
Beat {{ing:cream-cheese}} with the zest and juice of {{ing:lemon}}.
Fold in the salmon and chopped {{ing:fresh-dill}}.
Season with {{ing:black-pepper-ground}}. Chill 30 minutes.
Serve with {{ing:oatcakes}}.
Halve, stone and dice {{ing:avocado}}. Toss with the juice of one {{ing:lime}}.
Put {{ing:crab-white-meat}} in a bowl. Pick out any shell.
Chop {{ing:chilli-fresh}} and {{ing:fresh-coriander}}. Stir into the crab with {{ing:olive-oil}}.
Spoon the avocado into glasses. Top with the crab.
Serve with wedges of the other lime.
Fry chopped {{ing:onion-medium}} in {{ing:olive-oil}} 8 minutes.
Add {{ing:ginger-fresh}}. Fry 1 minute.
Slice {{ing:carrot-large}}. Add with {{ing:stock-vegetable}}. Simmer 20 minutes, until soft.
Add {{ing:coconut-milk-tinned}}. Blend until smooth.
Scatter with {{ing:fresh-coriander}}.

recipes.name: Pea and mint hummus with crudités

steps.instruction: Cook {{ing:peas-frozen}} in boiling water 3 minutes. Cool under cold water.
Drain {{ing:chickpeas-tinned}}.
Blend the peas, chickpeas, {{ing:tahini}}, the juice of {{ing:lemon}} and {{ing:garlic-clove}}.
Add {{ing:fresh-mint}} and {{ing:olive-oil}}. Blend until smooth.
Cut {{ing:carrot-medium}} into sticks. Halve {{ing:radish}}. Serve for dipping.
Melt {{ing:butter-unsalted}} in a pan. Chop {{ing:onion-medium}}. Fry 8 minutes.
Add {{ing:peas-frozen}} and {{ing:stock-chicken}}. Simmer 5 minutes.
Blend until smooth.
Shred {{ing:ham-slice}}. Stir in most of it.
Top with the rest of the ham and {{ing:fresh-mint}}.
Put a frying pan on a high heat. Add {{ing:olive-oil}}.
Fry {{ing:lamb-mince}} 8 minutes, breaking it up, until browned.
Add {{ing:cumin-ground}} and {{ing:cinnamon-ground}}. Fry 1 minute.
Warm {{ing:pitta-bread}}. Cut each into four.
Top with the lamb, a spoon of {{ing:natural-yoghurt}}, {{ing:pomegranate-seeds}} and {{ing:fresh-mint}}.

recipes.name: Baked camembert with garlic and rosemary
recipes.method_note: Most camembert is made with animal rennet; check if that matters.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C. Take {{ing:camembert}} out of its wrapping. Put back in its box.
Cut small slits in the top.
Slice {{ing:garlic-clove}}. Push slivers and {{ing:fresh-rosemary}} into the slits.
Drizzle with {{ing:honey}}. Bake 15 minutes, until molten.
Toast {{ing:sourdough}}. Cut into soldiers for dipping.

recipes.name: Slow-cooked lamb with lemon and oregano
recipes.method_note: The foil keeps the steam in. That is what makes it fall apart.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 160C.
Cut slits in {{ing:lamb-leg}}. Push in sliced {{ing:garlic-clove}}.
Rub with the juice of {{ing:lemon}}, {{ing:dried-oregano}} and {{ing:olive-oil}}.
Cut {{ing:potato-large}} and {{ing:red-onion}} into wedges. Put in a deep tin. Sit the lamb on top.
Pour in {{ing:wine-white}}. Cover tightly with foil.
Cook 4 hours, until the meat falls from the bone. Uncover for the last 30 minutes.
Put {{ing:gammon-joint}} in a large pan. Cover with cold water. Add the juice of one {{ing:orange}} and {{ing:bay-leaf}}.
Simmer 1 hour 40 minutes. Lift out. Cool a little.
Heat the oven to 200C. Cut off the skin, leaving the fat.
Score the fat into diamonds. Push a clove from {{ing:cloves}} into each.
Mix {{ing:maple-syrup}}, {{ing:mustard-dijon}} and the zest of the second orange. Brush over.
Roast 25 minutes, brushing twice, until sticky and golden.

recipes.name: Roast chicken with lemon and tarragon

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C.
Mix soft {{ing:butter-unsalted}} with chopped {{ing:fresh-tarragon}} and the zest of {{ing:lemon}}.
Push the butter under the skin of {{ing:chicken-whole}}.
Put the zested lemon and {{ing:garlic-clove}} inside the bird. Sit in a tin.
Roast 1 hour 20 minutes, until the juices run clear.
Rest 15 minutes. Add {{ing:wine-white}} to the tin. Bubble on the hob for a quick gravy.
Heat the oven to 200C. Lay {{ing:salmon-fillet}} on a lined tray.
Chop {{ing:fresh-parsley}} and {{ing:fresh-dill}}. Mix with {{ing:breadcrumbs-dried}}, the zest of {{ing:lemon}} and {{ing:olive-oil}}.
Brush the salmon with {{ing:mustard-dijon}}.
Press the crumbs on top.
Roast 15 minutes, until the crumbs are golden and the fish flakes.
Serve with lemon wedges.

recipes.name: Hake with crushed peas and mint

steps.instruction: Cook {{ing:peas-frozen}} 3 minutes. Drain.
Crush with 2 tbsp of {{ing:olive-oil}}, chopped {{ing:fresh-mint}} and the juice of {{ing:lemon}}.
Dust {{ing:hake-fillet}} in {{ing:flour-plain}}.
Fry in the rest of the oil 4 minutes skin side down. Turn. Cook 2 minutes more.
Serve on the crushed peas.
Warm {{ing:stock-vegetable}}. Melt half of {{ing:butter-unsalted}} in a wide pan.
Chop {{ing:shallot}}. Fry 4 minutes. Add {{ing:rice-arborio-dry}}. Stir 1 minute.
Add {{ing:wine-white}}. Add the stock a ladle at a time, stirring, about 18 minutes.
Add {{ing:peas-frozen}} for the last 4 minutes. Stir in the rest of the butter and the zest of {{ing:lemon}}.
Sear {{ing:scallops}} in {{ing:olive-oil}} on a high heat 90 seconds a side.
Serve the scallops on the risotto.
Heat the oven to 190C. Fry chopped {{ing:onion-medium}} in 1 tbsp of {{ing:olive-oil}} 6 minutes.
Add {{ing:spinach}}. Stir until wilted. Squeeze out the water in a sieve.
Mix the spinach with crumbled {{ing:feta}}, {{ing:ricotta}}, {{ing:egg-medium}} and {{ing:nutmeg}}.
Layer 6 sheets of {{ing:filo-pastry}} in a dish, brushing each with oil.
Spread in the filling. Scrunch the last sheets on top. Brush with oil.
Bake 40 minutes, until crisp and golden.
Heat the oven to 190C. Line a 23 cm tin with {{ing:shortcrust-pastry}}.
Bake 15 minutes with baking beans. Take them out.
Slice {{ing:leek}}. Fry in {{ing:butter-unsalted}} 10 minutes, until soft.
Whisk {{ing:egg-medium}}, {{ing:double-cream}} and {{ing:nutmeg}}.
Spread the leeks in the case. Scatter grated {{ing:gruyere}}. Pour over the cream.
Lower the oven to 170C. Bake 30 minutes, until barely set.

swaps.text: Mature cheddar, or a vegetarian Alpine-style cheese

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C. Boil halved {{ing:new-potatoes}} 10 minutes. Drain.
Slice {{ing:leek}}. Fry in {{ing:butter-unsalted}} 6 minutes.
Stir in {{ing:flour-plain}}. Add {{ing:stock-vegetable}} slowly until thick.
Add the potatoes, {{ing:asparagus}} in short lengths, {{ing:peas-frozen}} and {{ing:creme-fraiche}}.
Tip into a pie dish. Top with {{ing:puff-pastry}}. Brush with beaten {{ing:egg-medium}}.
Bake 30 minutes, until golden.

recipes.name: Whole roast cauliflower with herbs and pistachios

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C. Trim the leaves of {{ing:cauliflower-head}}.
Boil whole 8 minutes. Drain.
Rub with 2 tbsp of {{ing:olive-oil}} and {{ing:cumin-ground}}. Roast 40 minutes, until browned.
Chop {{ing:fresh-parsley}} and {{ing:fresh-mint}}. Mix with the rest of the oil and the juice of {{ing:lemon}}.
Spoon over the cauliflower.
Scatter with chopped {{ing:pistachios}} and {{ing:pomegranate-seeds}}.
Fry chopped {{ing:onion-medium}} in {{ing:olive-oil}} 8 minutes.
Add {{ing:ras-el-hanout}}. Fry 1 minute.
Add sliced {{ing:carrot-medium}}, drained {{ing:chickpeas-tinned}}, {{ing:chopped-tomatoes-tinned}}, {{ing:dried-apricots}} and {{ing:stock-vegetable}}.
Simmer 25 minutes, until the carrots are tender.
Pour 300 ml boiling water over {{ing:couscous-dry}}. Cover 5 minutes. Fluff.
Serve the tagine on the couscous. Scatter {{ing:fresh-coriander}}.
Heat the oven to 190C. Halve {{ing:pepper-bell}}. Take out the seeds.
Fry chopped {{ing:red-onion}} and {{ing:garlic-clove}} in 2 tbsp of {{ing:olive-oil}} 8 minutes.
Stir in drained {{ing:lentils-tinned}}, {{ing:rice-white-cooked}}, the zest and juice of {{ing:lemon}} and chopped {{ing:fresh-parsley}}.
Fill the peppers. Sit in a dish with halved {{ing:cherry-tomato}}.
Drizzle with the rest of the oil.
Bake 35 minutes, until the peppers are soft.
Heat the oven to 200C.
Halve {{ing:new-potatoes}}. Toss with {{ing:olive-oil}}, {{ing:fresh-rosemary}}, whole {{ing:garlic-clove}} and {{ing:salt}}.
Roast 40 minutes, shaking once, until crisp.
Cook {{ing:peas-frozen}} in boiling water 3 minutes.
Drain.
Toss with {{ing:olive-oil}} and chopped {{ing:fresh-mint}}.
Heat the oven to 200C.
Halve {{ing:carrot-medium}} lengthways. Toss with {{ing:olive-oil}} and {{ing:cumin-ground}}.
Roast 25 minutes.
Drizzle with {{ing:honey}}. Roast 10 minutes more, until sticky.
Melt {{ing:butter-unsalted}} in a large pan. Add crushed {{ing:garlic-clove}}.
Add {{ing:spinach}} in handfuls, stirring until wilted.
Tip into a sieve. Press out the water.
Return to the pan with {{ing:double-cream}} and {{ing:nutmeg}}. Bubble 2 minutes.
Cut {{ing:broccoli-head}} into florets. Boil 4 minutes. Drain.
Chop {{ing:almonds}}. Toast in {{ing:olive-oil}} 2 minutes, until golden.
Toss with the broccoli.
Squeeze over {{ing:lemon}}.

recipes.name: Simnel cake
recipes.method_note: Eleven balls, for the apostles without Judas.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 150C. Line a 20 cm deep tin.
Beat {{ing:butter-unsalted}} and {{ing:sugar-soft-brown}}. Beat in {{ing:egg-medium}}.
Fold in {{ing:flour-plain}}, {{ing:mixed-spice}}, {{ing:sultanas}}, {{ing:currants}} and {{ing:mixed-peel}}.
Put half in the tin. Roll a third of {{ing:marzipan}} into a disc. Lay on top. Add the rest.
Bake 2 hours 15 minutes, until a skewer comes out clean. Cool.
Brush with warm {{ing:jam-strawberry}}. Cover with a disc of marzipan. Roll 11 balls for the top.

recipes.name: Hot cross bun bread and butter pudding

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 170C.
Halve {{ing:hot-cross-bun}}. Spread with {{ing:butter-unsalted}}. Layer in a dish.
Whisk {{ing:egg-medium}}, {{ing:milk-whole}}, {{ing:double-cream}}, {{ing:sugar-caster}} and {{ing:vanilla-extract}}.
Pour over. Leave 15 minutes to soak.
Bake 35 minutes, until set and golden.

recipes.name: Chocolate Easter nests
recipes.method_note: A good one to make with children.

steps.instruction: Break {{ing:milk-chocolate-bar}} into a bowl with {{ing:butter-unsalted}} and {{ing:golden-syrup}}.
Melt over a pan of barely simmering water, stirring.
Stir in {{ing:cornflakes}} until coated.
Spoon into 12 paper cases. Press a dip in the middle.
Chill 1 hour, until set. Fill with small chocolate eggs.
Heat the oven to 190C. Line a 23 cm tin with {{ing:shortcrust-pastry}}. Bake 20 minutes with baking beans.
Mix {{ing:cornflour}} with 100 g of {{ing:sugar-caster}}, the zest and juice of {{ing:lemon}} and 250 ml water.
Stir over a medium heat until thick. Take off the heat. Beat in {{ing:butter-unsalted}}.
Separate {{ing:egg-medium}}. Beat the yolks into the lemon. Pour into the case.
Whisk the whites stiff. Whisk in the rest of the sugar a spoon at a time, until glossy.
Pile on top. Bake at 160C for 20 minutes, until golden.

recipes.name: Carrot cake with cream cheese icing

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 180C. Line a 20 cm tin.
Whisk {{ing:vegetable-oil}}, {{ing:sugar-soft-brown}} and {{ing:egg-medium}}.
Fold in {{ing:flour-self-raising}} and {{ing:cinnamon-ground}}.
Grate {{ing:carrot-medium}}. Stir in with chopped {{ing:walnuts}}.
Bake 50 minutes, until a skewer comes out clean. Cool.
Beat {{ing:cream-cheese}} with {{ing:icing-sugar}}. Spread over the top.
Melt {{ing:dark-chocolate-70}} over a pan of barely simmering water.
Blend {{ing:tofu-silken}} until smooth.
Add the chocolate, {{ing:maple-syrup}} and {{ing:vanilla-extract}}. Blend until glossy.
Spoon into 4 glasses. Chill 2 hours, until set.
Top with {{ing:raspberries}}.
Melt {{ing:dark-chocolate-70}} over a pan of barely simmering water.
Hold {{ing:strawberries}} by the stalk. Dip halfway into the chocolate.
Sprinkle some with {{ing:desiccated-coconut}}.
Lay on baking paper. Chill 30 minutes, until set.
Heat the oven to 180C. Line a 900 g loaf tin.
Mash {{ing:banana-medium}}.
Melt {{ing:dairy-free-spread}}. Mix with the banana, {{ing:sugar-soft-brown}} and {{ing:oat-milk}}.
Fold in {{ing:flour-self-raising}}, {{ing:cocoa-powder}} and chopped {{ing:dark-chocolate-70}}.
Bake 50 minutes, until a skewer comes out clean.
Pour {{ing:orange-juice}} into a jug.
Halve {{ing:passion-fruit}}. Scoop in the seeds.
Top up with {{ing:sparkling-water}} and ice.
Pour {{ing:water}}, boiling, over {{ing:tea-bags}}. Leave 4 minutes. Take out the bags.
Stir in {{ing:honey}}. Cool.
Add sliced {{ing:lemon}} and {{ing:fresh-mint}}.
Chill. Serve over ice.
Peel and stone {{ing:peach}}. Blend with {{ing:sugar-caster}} until smooth.
Put 2 spoons in each glass.
Top up slowly with chilled {{ing:sparkling-wine}}.

steps.instruction: Divide {{ing:orange-liqueur}} and {{ing:orange-juice}} between 6 glasses.
Add ice.
Top up with {{ing:sparkling-wine}}.
Add a slice of {{ing:orange}}.

swaps.text: Check the label says vegan if you need it to be
